Code inspection of canary/world.py and canary/env.py indicates decoy and mole are uniform, day-1 has no leaks or logs, and wrong_accusation_score=-1.0 is strictly enforced, so an honest EV-gated gambler (accusing only if P > 1/(1+V)) should almost always abstain and score 0.0.

This probe tests a day-2 Bayesian stop-early gambler that eliminates the decoy, checks day-1 roster/doc patterns, updates on day-1 after-hours logs plus 4-topic interviews on the top suspect, and gates accusation strictly on positive expected value P(mole) > 1/(1+V).
